headline: Today is the clean window and it closes Friday - ride today, not 'sometime this week'.
body:
Yesterday's call holds, and the live forecast now backs it. Today is the calmest day in the whole file: gusts **19 km/h** early, **23** midday and evening, zero rain, **19-20 C** - good for bike, run and open water in every window. Tomorrow still rides at **39 km/h**. Then it shuts: Saturday runs **58-70 km/h** SSE with bike 'poor' all day, Sunday **75-82 km/h**, bike 'no'. Two clean days, then nothing.

So take it today. **45 min at 26-28 km/h on 131-150 bpm**, flattest road you have, nothing over **150** and no climbing efforts. First ride back off a six-hour race is circulation, not training.

The pipeline is still dead. **training.json** is stamped 17 September, **158.7 hours** old, **fourteen** push windows missed, eleven days without a file and no HRV since 13 September - so I am prescribing blind and keeping it easy because of that.

Charge the watch and force a sync. Then: your four splits, and how the ankle is now.
